# `randstr`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a string of the specified length whose characters are chosen
uniformly at random from the following pool of characters: 0-9, a-z, A-Z. The random seed is
optional. The string length must be a constant two-byte or four-byte integer (SMALLINT or INT,
respectively).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
randstr(length[, seed])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|

| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
-- randstr, example 1
> SELECT randstr(3, 0) AS result;
ceV
```
